newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National, Lloyds shares drop.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National, Lloyds shares drop.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc and Lloyds TSB Group Plc dropped on Thursday amid profit-taking after recent gains and signs of intensifying competition in the mortgage market, dealers said.

Abbey shares, which reached a near record 806p in early trading, were down 12p at 790 by 1250 GMT, while shares in Lloyds -- which owns mortgage lender Cheltenham & Gloucester -- were down 10-1/2p at 521, after yesterday hitting a record 537-3/4.
offering a new range of mortgage cashback offers worth up to 10,000 stg per loan as part of a bid to increase market share.
Also yesterday, Woolwich building society said it almost doubled its share of new mortgage lending to 7.6 percent after a series of expensive special offers.
"We have seen a few sellers on the back of news from the Halifax and Woolwich," said one market-maker.
Earlier this week, Abbey and Lloyds shares benefitted from switching out of Barclays after it posted disappointing results for 1996.
